analysis_contract.scope: One complete deterministic rotation of this pinned 170-pool population, beginning at the pinned first bucket. Continue only forward; no backfill or response-based replacement.
analysis_contract.planned_opportunity_unit: One (bucket_close_ns, pool_id) listed in a durable immutable plan and matching plan journal event.
analysis_contract.planned_opportunity_denominator: Every selected pool in every durable plan counts, including no-intent slots, explicit missed outcomes, ambiguous spent requests, provider failures, empty responses, and malformed or unsupported responses.
analysis_contract.scheduled_bucket_denominator: Durable plans plus durable gap events.
analysis_contract.planned_pool_opportunity_denominator: Sum of selected_pool_ids across durable plans only; a plan slot counts even if it has no intent or response.
analysis_contract.unplanned_gap_handling: Count every durable gap bucket separately as an unplanned unavailable interval with unknown pool selection and zero pool-opportunity slots. A gap has selected_pool_ids=null and cursor_out=cursor_in. Do not reconstruct or attribute pool slots, advance the cursor, or backfill that gap.
analysis_contract.post_gap_selection: The next durable plan begins from the unchanged cursor and uses only retention/evidence available before that plan.
analysis_contract.gap_replay_tests: Reject any gap carrying pool IDs or advancing the cursor; verify a following plan uses the pre-gap cursor and only its own prior-known retention evidence.
analysis_contract.rotation_stop_for_audit: End the first-rotation audit only after each of the 170 pinned pool IDs has appeared in at least one durable plan; a gap does not satisfy pool exposure.
transport_and_bar_metrics: existing parser dispositions: eligible_new_open, eligible_overlap_revision, excluded_unclosed, excluded_out_of_window
per-pool and UTC age-band opportunity/exposure counts
unplanned gap buckets, unresolved or ambiguous states, and explicit unknown denominators
analysis_contract.time_and_provenance: Preserve event bar-open time, decision/bucket time, request start, provider receipt, durable availability/confirmation time, raw response hash, source/policy/selector/population pins, and root/volume identity as distinct facts.
analysis_contract.age_band_policy: Derive age only from independently pinned birth evidence with an explicit knowledge/availability time. Use existing 0-3d, 3-7d, and 7d+ boundaries only where birth-time uncertainty permits exact classification; otherwise retain unknown.
analysis_contract.missingness_and_lifecycle: A missing bar, empty response, unplanned gap, or pool disappearance remains unknown and never implies zero activity, inactivity, or death.
analysis_contract.downstream_projection: Emit read-only replay/audit first. Project only source-qualified bars into existing population/sparse coverage interfaces; keep capture and qualified coverage separate.
analysis_contract.collection_change: None; cadence, selector, caps, release root, provider and forward-only policy remain unchanged.
